name: deliberate
description: Ask about your ecommerce business in ChatGPT: revenue, ads, customers and your team's notes, answered from your own connected tools by Deliberate's agent team. Reads and drafts only.

interface.longDescription:
Deliberate brings your ecommerce business into ChatGPT. Connect it once and ask about your store in plain language: how last week went, what is selling, how your ads and email are doing, and what your customers are saying. Answers come from your own connected tools, such as Shopify, Meta, Google Ads, Klaviyo and your support desk, with the dates and numbers they are based on.

What you can do
- Ask how the business is doing over any recent period, with revenue, orders, ad spend, MER and new customers.
- Get a read from Deliberate's agent team, which knows your business, your metrics and your team's saved research.
- Search what your team has written down: decisions, plans, briefs and meeting notes.
- Draft a weekly update, a performance readout or a customer support reply to review and send yourself.

How it works
Each person signs in with their own Deliberate login. If you belong to more than one workspace, you pick which one. ChatGPT only sees the workspace you choose, and only what the people on that workspace can see. Requires an existing Deliberate workspace.

Your data stays yours
- The connection reads and drafts. It does not send email, change your store, edit your ads or post anything.
- Questions you ask through ChatGPT, and the answers, go to OpenAI under its terms.
- An owner or admin can turn ChatGPT off for the workspace at any time in Settings, and removing someone from the team ends their connection.
capabilities: Read revenue, orders, ad spend, MER and new customers for any recent period
Ask Deliberate's agent team about the business
Search the team's saved notes, plans and research
Draft readouts, updates and support replies to review and send yourself
defaultPrompt: How did revenue and orders do last week compared with the week before?
What should we pay attention to in the business this week?
Draft a short weekly performance update I can send to my team.

positive.description: Revenue last week compared with the week before
positive.prompt: How did revenue and orders do last week compared with the week before?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_metrics with period last_week (and may call it again for the prior week). Returns revenue, orders and ad spend for the previous Monday to Sunday with the exact dates named, and the change against the week before. No invented numbers.

positive.description: Ask the agent team for a read on the business
positive.prompt: What should we pay attention to in the business this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ask; if it returns an ask_id, calls get_answer with that id. Returns a short read of the business from Deliberate's agent team that cites figures from the workspace's own data.

positive.prompt: What's our MER and new customer count so far this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_metrics with period month_to_date. Returns MER and new customers for the month so far, labeled as month to date, with the date range.

positive.prompt: Has the team written anything down about our referral program?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_context with keywords such as referral and get_context for any match. Returns the matching note's content, or says plainly that nothing has been saved on it.

positive.prompt: Draft a short weekly performance update I can send to my team.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls draft_readout (it may call get_metrics first). Returns a draft update grounded in the workspace's numbers, clearly marked as a draft. Nothing is sent or saved.

negative.description: Request to send email. The connector has no send tool; ChatGPT should offer a draft instead and say it cannot send through Deliberate.
negative.prompt: Email this update to our whole customer list.

negative.description: Request for another business's data. Only the signed-in workspace's data is ever returned; ChatGPT should say it only has access to this workspace.
negative.prompt: Show me Loftie's revenue last week.

negative.description: Request to change the store. The connector cannot edit products, prices, ads or orders; ChatGPT should say so and offer to draft the change for the user to make.
negative.prompt: Cut the price of our best seller by 20% and pause all our Meta ads.

review.commerce_description: Deliberate does not sell products, show prices or process payments in ChatGPT. It reads a business's own data and drafts text for the user to review.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read business metrics, ask Deliberate's agent team, search the team's saved notes, and draft readouts and support replies. Read and draft only.
